text.headline: Timeline of Uganda
text.text: Major events in the history of Uganda.

events.headline: Bantu Kingdoms
events.text: Buganda, Bunyoro, and Toro emerge around the Great Lakes.

events.headline: Speke Reaches Lake Victoria
events.text: John Hanning Speke searches for the Nile’s source.

events.headline: British Protectorate
events.text: Buganda and neighboring areas come under British rule.

events.headline: Independence
events.text: Uganda gains independence with Milton Obote as PM.

events.headline: Idi Amin Coup
events.text: General Idi Amin seizes power, ruling by terror.

events.headline: Amin Overthrown
events.text: Tanzanian forces and Ugandan exiles oust Amin.

events.headline: Museveni Takes Power
events.text: NRA captures Kampala, ending years of conflict.

events.headline: LRA Rebellion Ends
events.text: Government defeats the Lord’s Resistance Army insurgency.

events.headline: Contested Election
events.text: Museveni wins a sixth term amid disputes.

events.headline: Growth & Rights Controversies
events.text: Economic expansion continues amid rights concerns.
